The '''''Lsumu''''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|Carrack-class light cruiser]] that was originally going to rendezvous with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] at [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] but was [[Ambush at Sul-34|destroyed]] by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in a [[Missile Boat]].
